messages:
anna-h: Heads-up — observed ~6% undercount in hourly agg for model_infer counts for a subset of EU shards starting 2026-03-01. Looks like late shard commits arriving out-of-order.
samir: Ugh. Is this the partial-commit bug we fixed last month or a new windowing problem?
keisha: New pattern. The reingest job we ran last week created partial checkpoints for shards 8-14, then the producer re-tried and wrote overlapping ranges. Downstream aggregator assumed monotonic commits and skipped some windows.
matt-p: Can we avoid full recompute? Maybe target only the missing hour ranges and replay idempotently.
anna-h: Agree. Proposal: 1) pause realtime downstream consumers for affected aggregates for a short controlled window, 2) run shard-aligned backfills for the exact missing ranges, 3) apply idempotent merge logic so replays don't double-count.
chao: How confident are we in identifying missing ranges? Do we have watermarks per shard?
keisha: We have commit_log.high_watermark and last_agg_ts per shard. I can diff them and emit the exact [start,end) ranges.
samir: We should cap concurrency to avoid impacting prod SLO. Suggest max 6 parallel backfill workers across region and throttle at 200 req/s to the aggregator.
anna-h: Good. Also need to ensure the backfill tool sets a special replay_tag so metrics/alerts reflect replay traffic.
eng-replay-bot: backfillctl detected target_shards=[8,9,10,11,12,13,14], estimated_rows=1.2M, est_duration=2h30m at concurrency=4
matt-p: Example run command for ops team:

```
backfillctl run --replay-tag=shard-align-0301 --shards=8-14 --start=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z \
  --end=2026-03-03T00:00:00Z --concurrency=4 --idempotent
```

keisha: Important: set --idempotent and ensure aggregator's merge_key is (model_id, hour, shard) — we added merge_tombstones last month.
samir: Who can own the orchestration? Airflow DAG or ad-hoc runbook? Airflow would be better for audit and resume.
anna-h: Let's run it from temp Airflow dag with a manual trigger and opt-in roll-forward on failure. Keisha, can you submit the DAG by EOD?
keisha: Yes, will add a pre-hook to pause the realtime consumer and post-hook to resume.
matt-p: Need an escape hatch: if replay time >3h or error rate spikes (5xx >1%), abort and fallback to full recompute planning.
chao: I'll add SLO watchers on Grafana: replay-tag and aggregator-duplicate-rate panel. Also add a synthetic check to ensure counts increase by expected delta.
eng-replay-bot: backfillctl status: queued -> running on worker-7
samir: One more: ensure KV-cache rehydrate is disabled during replay to avoid cache thrash. We only want aggregator writes, not cache writes.
keisha: Good catch. backfillctl will run with --no-cache-write. I'll push that env in the DAG.
anna-h: ETA for the diff ranges?
keisha: Pushing list now: [shard 8: 2026-03-01T02:00Z-04:00Z], [9: 01:00Z-03:00Z], [10: full 00:00Z-24:00Z], [11: missing tails 22:00Z-24:00Z], [12-14: small gaps]. I'm attaching the exact CSV in the DAG params.
matt-p: After run, we need a reconciliation job that compares pre/post counts and marks the shard as reconciled if delta matches expected within 0.5%.
chao: I'll add a nightly job to re-run reconciliation for 48h to catch stragglers.
samir: Any customer-facing fallout? Telemetry dashboard shows lower counts, but no product impact reported yet.
anna-h: Notify CS briefly with 'telemetry backfill in progress — counts may change' template. Samir, can you post to #customer-success?
samir: On it.
keisha: Starting the DAG on manual trigger now. I'll post updates here. :rocket:
eng-replay-bot: job shard-align-0301 started; run_id=shard-align-0301-20260305-01
matt-p: Thanks. Keep an eye on CPU on aggregator nodes — throttle if p95 latency > 350ms.
keisha: First batch done for shards 8-10. No dupes observed so far. Progress 28%.
chao: Reconciler shows counts rising toward expected. Will wait for full run before marking reconciled.
anna-h: Good job team. Postmortem later to cover why producer retried overlapping ranges and how to avoid partial checkpoints.
